help:
What you say here goes to Persona's main chat, and answers come back here.
/new start a new chat (you can put the first message right after it)
/main back to the main chat
/stop stop the current turn
/status where messages go and how many answers are pending
/help these commands
When an agent asks you something or needs approval, just reply with a number or text.
now_to_main: Messages now go to the main chat.
next_is_new: OK, your next message starts a new chat. /main goes back to the main chat.
next_new_chat: A new chat from your next message
machine_gone: That chat's computer is gone. Send /main to go back to the main chat
chat_gone: That chat is gone. Send /main to go back to the main chat
answer_not_sent:
Your last reply didn't go through: {error}
It's still waiting for your reply — just send the same answer again.
more_waiting_one: {count} more waiting for your reply; the latest is the second-to-last message above.
more_waiting_other: {count} more waiting for your reply; the latest is the second-to-last message above.
fill_in_app: This step has something to fill in in the Persona app. Here it can only be declined.
